# Relaticle Contributor License Agreement

Version 1.0, effective 2026-11-01.

This agreement covers every Contribution you make to a Relaticle Project. You accept it by posting, as a comment on your pull request, the signing sentence the CLA bot asks for. You accept it once, and it covers your earlier and later Contributions.

## Definitions

- **You**: the individual who accepts this agreement. If a company or other legal entity owns rights in Your Contributions, You confirm it has authorized You to accept this agreement for it. In that case "You" also means that entity.
- **Relaticle**: Relaticle, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its successors and assigns.
- **Project**: any software project Relaticle owns or manages, open source or not, including the whole `relaticle/relaticle` repository (`packages/Cloud` included) and the `relaticle/custom-fields` repository.
- **Contribution**: any work You Submit to a Project, including changes or additions to existing work, whether Submitted before or after You accept this agreement.
- **Submit**: to send to a Project through a pull request, commit, issue, or any other written, electronic, or verbal communication with Relaticle or a Project's maintainers. Anything You clearly mark "Not a Contribution" when You send it is not Submitted.

## What each side gives

Relaticle merges pull requests only from people who have accepted this agreement. In exchange for the review of Your work, the chance to have it included in a Project, and Relaticle's promise below, You grant the licenses in this agreement for Your earlier and later Contributions.

Anyone who receives software containing Your Contributions gets their rights from Relaticle, under the license Relaticle distributes that software under.

Relaticle may license Your Contributions under any terms, open source or proprietary. These include the GNU AGPL, additional permissions such as the Relaticle Integration Exception, commercial licenses, and the Relaticle Cloud License. Relaticle may use Your Contributions in any part of a Project, including `packages/Cloud`, and in software that is not open source.

Relaticle promises to also license each Contribution it distributes under the license the Project used for that Contribution on the date You Submitted it.

Except for the licenses in this agreement, You keep all right, title, and interest in Your Contributions. Some files carry a license saying Relaticle owns changes to them, such as the Relaticle Cloud License. For Contributions You Submit under this agreement, this agreement controls instead: You keep ownership, and Relaticle receives the licenses in this agreement.

## Moral rights

To the extent the law allows, You waive any moral rights You have in Your Contributions, such as the right to object to changes. You agree not to assert them against Relaticle, its successors, or anyone who receives Your Contributions from Relaticle.

## Your promises

- You are legally entitled to grant the licenses in this agreement.
- Each Contribution is Your original work, except for parts You clearly mark in the pull request with their source and license. You may Submit those parts under that license, and You have told Relaticle about every license, patent, or other restriction on them that You know of.
- If Your employer, a client, or anyone else has rights in Your Contributions, they have allowed You to Submit them under this agreement or have waived those rights.

- If an AI tool wrote part of a Contribution, You have reviewed that part, and the tool's terms let You Submit it under this agreement.

If You are under 18, or under the age of majority where You live, a parent or legal guardian must accept this agreement with You. Write to hello@relaticle.com before You sign.

## No other obligations

Relaticle has no obligation to use Your Contributions, and You are not expected to support them. Your Contributions are provided "as is", without warranties or conditions of any kind.

## General

Relaticle may assign or transfer this agreement and the licenses in it, in whole or in part, including in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, without Your consent.

A later version of this agreement applies only to Contributions You Submit after You accept that version.

Delaware law governs this agreement, without regard to its conflict of law rules. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.
